title: Friday Night Magic 2015: card flavor text

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: A group whose goblins rush into battle to satisfy their desire for violence and their desire not to be eaten.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A people whose great siege towers are moved by beasts across the endless sands.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: One of the clans, which saw only obstacles as the clans carved out their territories.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: A speaker who recalls how the clans carved out their territories and how her people saw allies where the Mardu saw obstacles.

relations.note: Contrasts her people's outlook with the Mardu's
relations.quote: "As the clans carved out their territories, we saw allies where the Mardu saw only obstacles."
